blocked.pattern: Would you like to (run the following command|make the following edits|grant these permissions)

notes: Patterns are calibrated from reviewed synthetic streams in tests/fixtures/agents/codex/synthetic-codex-tui and from reconstructed codex-cli 0.149.0 approval screens in tests/fixtures/agents/codex/0.149.0. approval-would matches the three approval headers shipped in the 0.149.0 binary; approval-choice anchors on the numbered Yes/No option list, which stays inside the bottom 15 lines even when a long command wraps the header out of view. Codex hides its status line while an approval modal is open, so a live 'Working (… esc to interrupt)' line below every blocked hit means the hit is stale transcript text; blocked_suppressed_by vetoes blocked in that case.
